memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it. They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish. — Josh 10:34-35 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The relentless advance continues, city after city, and here at Eglon we notice the steady, methodical progress of the campaign. There is no dramatic miracle recorded here, no sun standing still, no hailstones from heaven. Just faithful, ongoing obedience — moving forward, taking up positions, doing the work God had given them to do, one city at a time.

There is something worth learning in this ordinariness. The great miracle of the sun standing still gets all the attention, and rightly so. But much of Israel's conquest, and much of the Christian life, is made up of these less dramatic days of steady faithfulness. Not every day brings a spectacular display of God's power. Most days are ordinary days of simply pressing forward in obedience.

We can fall into the trap of only feeling close to God in the dramatic moments — the mountaintop experiences, the stunning answers to prayer. But God is just as present in the ordinary, methodical days of faithful obedience as He was in the day the sun stood still. The unremarkable days of quietly doing the next right thing are precious in His sight.

This teaches us not to despise the ordinary. Faithfulness in the undramatic seasons is the backbone of a life lived for God. As we are told, "whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord" (Col 3:23). Whether the day brings a great miracle or just another city to take, we press on with the same steady trust and obedience. God honours the faithfulness of ordinary days.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you only feel close to God in dramatic moments, or also in ordinary faithfulness?
2. How can you press forward faithfully even on unremarkable days?
3. What "next right thing" is God calling you to do steadily right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me value the ordinary days of steady obedience, not just the dramatic ones. Give me a faithful heart to press forward, working for You in all things. Amen.
